messages:
maya: Quick sync — need to lock the joint marketplace announcement cadence for Gaudi + MI300. Proposed rough timeline and asks below.
kevin: Can you paste dates? ops needs lead time for slotting.
maya: Proposal: dev-preview 2025-05-12, canary 2025-06-09, public listing 2025-06-23. Need SI dry-run week, driver artifacts, SKU tagging, and press embargo windows. :clipboard:
drew: I can run SI onramp for Gaudi images and mapping to marketplace SKUs. Need sample VM image and kernel notes. Where should I drop artifacts?
sara: I'll own MI300 driver bake + cert smoke. Targeting artifacts by `2025-05-22`. CI will run perf + thermal quickchecks.
alex: Ops note — we need slotting matrix, embargo window, and staging SKU names. Also legal/marketing copy for listing metadata. Please fill `./marketplace/checklists/joint-announce.md` by 2025-05-25.
kevin: Firmware/driver team wants a 2-week buffer before canary. Can we shift canary to 06-09 (from 06-02) to accommodate? :thinking:
maya: OK shifting to 06-09 to buy buffer. That makes public listing 06-23.
drew: I'll produce SI images and smoke artifacts. Upload target: `s3://rwd-partner/partners/gaudi-mi300/canary/`. Planning image v1 by 2025-05-20.
sara: CI smoke for driver v0.9 scheduled; posting logs when done. If thermal warnings persist we'll flag for firmware.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: marketplace-staging -> canary-2025-06-09 at 02:00 UTC. Please confirm manifests.
maya: Action items short list: 1) Drew: SI images by 2025-05-20. 2) Sara: driver artifacts by 2025-05-22. 3) Kevin: ops slotting matrix + embargo note by 2025-05-15. 4) Alex: marketplace metadata + legal ok by 2025-05-25. Reactions: :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll run slotting smoke in APAC region on 2025-05-27 and validate power derate lanes. Ping me for emergency reslot.
drew: Uploaded initial image v1: `s3://rwd-partner/partners/gaudi-mi300/canary/image-v1.tar.gz` — checksum `sha256:abc123...`
sara: CI smoke passed for driver v0.9. Logs snippet: ```
PASSED: pci_probe
PASSED: mmap_kv
WARN: thermthrottle (non-blocking)
```
alex: Ops check complete for staging SKUs, I added embargo window doc to the checklist and flagged legal. One ask: marketing wants a 1-paragraph tech blurb and 2 bullets on perf delta vs baseline.
maya: Thanks — scheduling 30m handoff meeting Thu 2025-05-29 16:00 PT. I'll post calendar invite and include the checklist link.
kevin: ack
alex: ack
sara: ack
drew: ack
